title: Director, Commercial Legal, Americas
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. Director, Legal Counsel, Americas About the Role We are seeking a US-based Director, Commercial Legal to lead Veeam’s Americas Commercial Legal team, supporting our fast-paced sales organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Commercial Legal, based in the UK, you will lead a team of four to five lawyers while remaining a key individual contributor. This highly visible, hands-on leadership role combines team oversight with direct involvement in complex software transactions. You will serve as the team’s escalation point while negotiating and closing strategic deals. The ideal candidate is an experienced technology commercial lawyer and proven people leader who thrives in a collaborative environment and stays closely connected to the business. What You’ll Do Partner closely with your EMEA counterpart to drive consistency across contracting positions, templates, playbooks, and processes, while sharing knowledge, best practices, and workload across regions. Negotiate and close a significant portfolio of complex, high-value agreements, including software, SaaS, BaaS, professional services, and channel transactions, partnering directly with Sales, Deal Desk, and other key stakeholders. Provide clear, practical, and commercially focused legal advice, balancing legal, regulatory, privacy, and commercial considerations with the needs of the business. Lead, coach, and develop the Americas Commercial Legal team, setting clear expectations, supporting professional growth, and addressing performance or people matters promptly and constructively. Build strong partnerships with Sales and sales leadership, developing a clear understanding of pipeline and business priorities to ensure the team has visibility across transactions and focuses resources where they will have the greatest impact. Develop and deliver training and practical guidance that enables Sales and other stakeholders to navigate contracting processes effectively and efficiently. Serve as the escalation point for complex, high-risk, or novel commercial matters, providing guidance while empowering team members to maintain ownership, and keeping Commercial Legal leadership informed of significant matters, emerging trends, and resourcing needs. Foster a positive, collaborative culture across the global Commercial Legal team and champion continuous improvement in how the team operates, partners with the business, and delivers results. What You’ll Bring Qualified lawyer admitted to practice in at least one U.S. state, with 12+ years of post-qualification experience gained at a leading law firm and/or in-house, including significant in-house experience within a software or technology company. Proven people leadership experience, with a track record of managing, coaching, and developing lawyers. Extensive hands-on experience negotiating and closing complex software and SaaS agreements in a fast-paced sales environment, with a desire to remain actively involved in transactions. Exceptional drafting and negotiation skills, with demonstrated experience partnering closely with Sales and other business stakeholders in the technology sector. Experience advising on privacy and data protection matters arising in commercial technology transactions. You will be a collaborative, team-oriented leader who views success as shared, contributes effectively as part of a broader leadership team, and brings a global perspective beyond their own region. Strong commercial judgment and the confidence to make pragmatic, risk-based decisions, including in situations where there may be limited precedent. Flexible, creative, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to balance the needs of Sales with appropriate legal and business risk, while exercising sound judgment on when to escalate. A credible and supportive leader who leads by example, effectively balancing a significant personal caseload with team leadership as business priorities evolve. Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to simplify complex legal issues, provide clear and practical guidance, and challenge stakeholders constructively. #LI-TI1 What you'll get Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning Compensation Transparency Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. title: Privacy Counsel
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the Role We are seeking an experienced U.S. based Privacy Counsel to join our Legal Team. In this role, you will help shape and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program as the company continues to expand internationally. You will advise on privacy, data protection, and AI governance issues across our products and operations, while supporting commercial transactions involving data processing and technology services. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and GTM teams to provide practical, business-oriented guidance that enables innovation while ensuring compliance with evolving privacy and AI regulatory frameworks across multiple jurisdictions. Responsibilities Advise on global privacy and data protection laws, including CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, and other U.S. and international regulatory frameworks. Advise on privacy and regulatory risks relating to AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, and other sensitive data types. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to implement privacy-by-design principles and support responsible development of AI products. Conduct and oversee privacy risk assessments, including Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)and related documentation. Support commercial transactions by advising on data protection terms, including Data Processing Addendums (DPAs), Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), cross-border data transfers, and privacy provisions in customer agreements. Monitor and interpret evolving legal and regulatory developments relating to privacy, AI governance, and data use, and translate them into practical guidance for the business. Help develop and maintain ElevenLabs’ privacy policies, procedures, and governance frameworks. Support responses to privacy-related regulatory inquiries, audits, and incidents, working closely with Security and Safety teams. Who you are Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, with a strong sense of ownership and enthusiasm for applying privacy law to cutting-edge products. Comfortable navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving regulatory landscapes. Able to translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for product and business teams. Collaborative, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented, with a strong commitment to enabling innovation responsibly. What you bring JD with active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (New York preferred). 6+ years of relevant legal experience, with a focus on privacy compliance and data governance. Experience advising AI, technology or SaaS companies on global privacy compliance and data governance. Experience advising on US biometric privacy laws and regulatory requirements, including laws governing biometric identifiers and information. Experience advising on HIPAA, healthcare privacy, PHI, and BAAs, particularly in connection with technology or SaaS products. Experience advising on AI, data use, or emerging technology regulatory frameworks is a strong plus. Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Location This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Governance Lead
description: Governance Lead The Opportunity Help shape how a large federal agency responsibly adopts artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to advance its mission. As the AI Governance Lead, you will assist in driving the development of enterprise policies, governance frameworks, and implementation guidance that enable innovation while addressing operational, legal, privacy, civil rights, and security considerations. You will work at the intersection of technology, policy, and mission delivery, advising federal executives and collaborating with technical teams to translate complex requirements into clear, actionable guidance. This role requires a strategic thinker who can build consensus across a decentralized organization, communicate effectively with various audiences, and guide governance initiatives from initial concept through enterprise adoption. What You’ll Work On: Assist in leading enterprise AI policy development, including assisting in developing and maintaining policies, standards, procedures, and implementation guidance for the acquisition, development, deployment, use, monitoring, and retirement of AI and emerging technologies. Design practical governance processes and establish decision rights, review boards, approval workflows, escalation paths, and exception processes that clarify accountability and support timely, risk-informed decisions. Translate requirements into implementation and assess applicable federal requirements and agency priorities, identify gaps, and coordinate with legal, privacy, civil rights, cybersecurity, acquisition, and technology stakeholders to develop actionable guidance. Address emerging AI capabilities and develop governance approaches for generative AI, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, third-party models, and AI embedded in enterprise applications, including expectations for human oversight, evaluation, and acceptable use. Connect policy to technical practices and partner with engineering, architecture, data, and cloud teams to define implementable requirements for AI inventories and model registries, evaluation, access controls, guardrails, monitoring, and supporting evidence. Build executive alignment and organizational consensus. Facilitate working groups, resolve competing stakeholder priorities, and prepare executive briefings, decision memoranda, and recommendations that explain options, tradeoffs, and mission implications. Measure governance effectiveness, establish performance measures, assess adoption and compliance, identify implementation barriers, and recommend improvements based on operational feedback, assessments, and changes in technology. Join us. The world can’t wait. You Have: 10+ years of experience in technology governance, technology policy, enterprise risk, or digital transformation 3+ years of experience in AI governance or AI policy Experience with assisting in leading enterprise technology policy or governance initiatives for a federal agency or a complex, regulated organization, assisting with authoring and implementing AI policies, standards, governance frameworks, or operational guidance Experience advising senior executives and assisting with producing concise, decision-oriented briefings, policy documents, and recommendations, developing communication, training, or organizational change strategies that support adoption of new policies and technology practices Experience in designing governance structures and processes, including review boards, risk assessments, approval criteria, accountability models, and exception management Knowledge of AI and generative AI capabilities, limitations, and risks, including model evaluation, data quality, bias, explainability, human oversight, and ongoing monitoring Ability to interpret federal policy and oversight requirements and translate them into clear responsibilities, decision processes, and implementation expectations, coordinate across technical teams, mission organizations, and oversight functions to resolve issues and implement enterprise guidance Ability to lead complex initiatives independently, manage competing priorities, and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements Bachelor’s degree Nice If You Have: Experience supporting large federal organization with law enforcement, security related, or sensitive missions Experience in assisting with developing governance for technologies that affect access to services or consequential government decisions Experience governing AI across multiple cloud providers, enterprise platforms, and self-hosted environments Experience establishing governance for AI agents, including delegated authority, tool access, human approvals, auditability, and incident escalation Experience defining contractual expectations for AI vendors, including evaluation evidence, data handling, model changes, transparency, and ongoing oversight

title: Senior Paid Social Manager
description: A BOUT TIDE At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. Tide facts: Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing Over $300 million raised in funding 3,000 Tideans globally Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026 We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg About You We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well. You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling. You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business. Some of the things you’ll be doing: Owning and scaling paid social performance globally , ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms. Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets , using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth. Building an AI-enabled paid social team , deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way. Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows , using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks. Using AI and automation across the account , from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work. Developing and executing the paid social roadmap , identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms. Driving a full-funnel approach , from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights. Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives. Championing attribution and measurement , ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation. Leading creative strategy , working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance. Staying ahead of industry changes , including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), AI-driven platform updates , and new advertising solutions. Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team , shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally. You’ll be a great fit if: You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms. You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social. You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices. You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms. You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making. You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.). You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation. You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain. You’re comfortable with Meta’s AI-led campaign products (Advantage+, automated bidding) and know when to trust automation and when to override it. You have sound judgement on AI risk, including brand safety, accuracy of claims and data privacy, ideally in a regulated industry such as financial services. You understand how to drive performance across web traffic, mobile apps, and lead generation channels. You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation. You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories. You have experience managing agency relationships, but also thrive in an in-house, hands-on environment. You’re a natural leader, with experience mentoring and growing a team of paid social professionals. Fluency in a second language (French or German) is preferable. What you’ll get in return: Make work, work for you! We embrace flexible working and remote-first arrangements. 25 days holiday + bank holidays. Vitality Health and Dental Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical well-being. £1,000 L&D budget per year, plus up to three L&D paid days off. Enhanced family-friendly leave. Work abroad for up to 90 days a year. Snacks, drinks, and social events in our offices. Tidean Ways of Working At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. We trust our employees to work in a way that suits them while delivering great results. Our offices are always available for those who want to collaborate in person, and we support remote work across the UK.   TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.  We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.   At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs.
